functional_parts.action_binding: RPC public.nayanet_send_smart_mail(p_sender_id uuid, p_receiver_id uuid, p_body text, p_subject text, p_kind text, p_idempotency_key text, p_project_id text) returns jsonb — creates thread+members+message+receipt+cognition event atomically; validates participants, body length <=10000, idempotency key required
functional_parts.auth: EXECUTE revoked from public, anon, authenticated; granted to service_role ONLY. Callers must be server-side.

data_contract.idempotency: replay-safe on (sender_id, metadata->>'idempotency_key'); returns status REPLAY with existing ids on duplicate; unique_violation handler
writes: public.v7_mail_messages (id, thread_id, sender_id, body, metadata jsonb with schema_version, correlation_id, idempotency_key, execution_receipt_id, cognition_event_id, governance, lifecycle)

functional_parts.name: Smart Mail send (atomic transaction)

functional_parts.action_binding: table-level CRUD via PostgREST under RLS; no dedicated RPC — the only privileged write path is NAYA-FN-001 (service_role)
functional_parts.auth: authenticated users, owner/member-scoped RLS (see rls above)

data_contract.rls: member-scoped: messages/threads readable only by thread members; message insert requires sender_id=auth.uid() AND membership in the thread; thread insert requires created_by=auth.uid()
tables: public.v7_mail_threads (id uuid PK, created_by uuid->auth.users, kind text in ('direct','room','group','list'), subject text, created_at)
public.v7_mail_members (thread_id uuid->v7_mail_threads, user_id uuid->auth.users, joined_at; PK(thread_id,user_id))
public.v7_mail_messages (id uuid PK, thread_id uuid->v7_mail_threads, sender_id uuid->auth.users, body text, audio_url text, metadata jsonb, created_at; constraint message_has_content)

functional_parts.name: Smart Mail message store (threads, members, messages)

functional_parts.action_binding: RPC public.nayanet_issue_authority_grant(p_subject_id uuid, p_source_event_id text, p_mission_id text, p_scope jsonb, p_actions jsonb, ...) returns nayanet_authority_grants — issues an ACTIVE grant after validating required fields, scope shape, non-empty actions, expiry in future
functional_parts.auth: EXECUTE granted to authenticated, revoked from anon and public; issuer must own the source cognition event (AUTHORITY_SOURCE_NOT_OWNED otherwise); issuer_id = auth.uid()

writes: public.nayanet_authority_grants (issuer_id, subject_id, source_event_id, mission_id, scope jsonb, actions jsonb, constraints jsonb, issued_at, expires_at, status, evidence jsonb, parent_authority jsonb)

functional_parts.name: Authority grant issuance

functional_parts.action_binding: RPCs public.get_booking_page(p_slug text), public.get_booking_windows(p_slug text), public.get_booked_starts(p_slug text, p_from timestamptz, p_to timestamptz) — read a page by slug, its availability windows, and booked start times in a range
functional_parts.auth: EXECUTE granted to anon AND authenticated (public booking flow)

reads: public.booking_pages (id, owner_alias, owner_id, slug unique, title, duration_minutes, active, calendar_sync_state, created_at, updated_at)
public.bookings (id, page_id->booking_pages, owner_alias, owner_id, visitor_name, visitor_email_hash, starts_at, ends_at, status default 'confirmed', note, cancel_token, created_at, updated_at)

functional_parts.name: Booking page and slot read

functional_parts.action_binding: RPC public.cancel_booking(p_booking_id uuid, p_cancel_token uuid) — flips a booking to cancelled after verifying the cancel token; inserts flow through bookings_guard_slot() (overlap/fit check) and bookings_fill_owner() (owner backfill); client-side validation helpers in HUB/booking/booking-core.mjs (validatePageInput, validateBookingRequest, computeSlots, planReminders)
functional_parts.auth: bookings_visitor_insert RLS policy lets anon visitors insert bookings; owner policies cover select/update/delete; RPC public.cancel_booking(p_booking_id uuid, p_cancel_token uuid) EXECUTE granted to anon+authenticated (token-authenticated cancel)

reads: view public.person_timeline_events (page_id, owner_alias, title, duration_minutes, calendar_sync_state)
writes: public.bookings (see NAYA-FN-004 fields); owner auto-filled by trigger bookings_fill_owner; slot conflicts guarded by trigger bookings_guard_slot

functional_parts.name: Booking create and cancel

functional_parts.action_binding: table-level CRUD via PostgREST under owner RLS; no dedicated RPC on main
functional_parts.auth: owner-scoped RLS (authenticated users see only their own lists/items)
functional_parts.name: Smart Lists store

functional_parts.action_binding: RPC public.resolve_smart_link(p_name text) — resolves a public smart-link name to its target_url (redirect hop); click events append to smart_link_clicks with attribution_id
functional_parts.auth: RPC public.resolve_smart_link(p_name text) EXECUTE granted to anon+authenticated (public redirect path); smart_links CRUD owner-RLS; trigger smart_links_guard_reserved() blocks reserved names

tables: public.smart_links (id uuid PK, owner_alias text, owner_id uuid, name text unique shape-constrained, target_url text shape-constrained, active boolean, created_at, updated_at)
public.smart_link_clicks (id uuid PK, link_id->smart_links, clicked_at, referrer_class, referrer_host, attribution_id uuid)

functional_parts.name: Smart Links resolve and click tracking

functional_parts.action_binding: table-level CRUD via PostgREST under owner RLS; no dedicated RPC on main
functional_parts.auth: owner-scoped RLS
functional_parts.name: Naya Notes store

functional_parts.action_binding: append-only event log for conversational intake flows (welcome/identity walks); no dedicated RPC on main
functional_parts.auth: anon AND authenticated may INSERT (public intake funnel); only authenticated may SELECT

data_contract.rls: intake_events_anon_insert and intake_events_auth_insert with check (true); authenticated select
tables: public.intake_events (id uuid PK, session_id text, flow text, event text, step_key text, step_index integer, owner_alias text, via text, answers jsonb, created_at; check constraints on known flow/event/via values)

functional_parts.name: Conversational intake event capture

functional_parts.action_binding: RPCs public.search_score(p_field text, p_query text) (scoring helper) and public.search_universal(p_query text, p_limit integer) (the service) — authenticated universal search over the user's content
functional_parts.auth: EXECUTE granted to authenticated only; revoked from public

reads: cross-vertical search surface (implementation scans owned content stores)

functional_parts.name: Universal search

functional_parts.action_binding: RPC public.claim_my_alias(p_alias text) — citizen claims a normalized alias (insert ... on conflict do nothing, rejects taken aliases); helper public.bind_owner_alias_claim(...) backfills; trigger bind_owner_alias() keeps owner_alias in sync on writes
functional_parts.auth: RPC public.claim_my_alias(p_alias text) EXECUTE granted to authenticated (revoked from public); trigger public.bind_owner_alias() auto-binds owner alias on row writes across owner-scoped tables

data_contract.rls: owner_alias_claims_owner_select: authenticated sees own claims (owner_id = auth.uid())
tables: public.owner_alias_claims (alias_normalized text PK, owner_id uuid, claimed_via text default 'backfill', claimed_at)

functional_parts.name: Owner alias claim and binding

functional_parts.action_binding: public.smart_match(a jsonb, b jsonb, value_b numeric default null) returns numeric — composite similarity score; helpers public.sm_stopwords/sm_terms/sm_stem/sm_words/sm_sig_words/sm_terms_content/sm_concepts (tokenizers) and public.sm_coeff/sm_family/sm_cross (coefficient combiners)
functional_parts.auth: no grant/revoke lines in the migration — immutable helper functions default to public execute; scoring is computation-only

data_contract.inputs: two jsonb attribute sets (a, b) plus optional value_b numeric; pure SQL, no table writes

functional_parts.name: Smart Match scoring engine

functional_parts.action_binding: database-enforced idempotency: repeat submissions of the same (user, project, action, idempotency_key) are rejected/merged at the unique index — the atomicity primitive the mail send (NAYA-FN-001) and verified actions (NAYA-FN-022) build on
functional_parts.auth: schema-level guard; enforced for all writers of execution receipts

data_contract.schema: public.nayanet_execution_receipts.idempotency_key text (nullable); unique index nayanet_execution_receipts_action_idempotency_uidx on (user_id, project_id, action, idempotency_key) where idempotency_key is not null

functional_parts.name: Action idempotency guard

functional_parts.action_binding: trigger-driven append-only ledger: smart note events and receipts auto-project into the hash-chained ledger (previous_chain_hash -> event_hash), preserving privacy_classification and evidence lineage
functional_parts.auth: RPC public.nayanet_record_ledger_event(...) EXECUTE revoked from public, anon, authenticated with NO grant — callable only via security-definer triggers (nayanet_smart_note_to_ledger, nayanet_smart_note_receipt_to_ledger) firing on smart_note_events / smart_note_receipts inserts

tables: public.nayanet_smart_ledger (ledger_event_id uuid PK, schema_version, owner_id->auth.users, actor_id, event_type, event_at, source_table, source_id, parent_ledger_event_id self-FK, previous_chain_hash, event_hash, privacy_classification default 'PRIVATE', status default 'RECORDED', evidence_refs jsonb, verification jsonb, value jsonb, outcome jsonb, learning_refs jsonb, metadata jsonb)

functional_parts.name: Smart ledger append (hash-chained)

functional_parts.action_binding: trigger public.nayanet_emit_intelligence_notification_from_receipt() — emits notifications off execution receipts; trigger public.nayanet_sync_intelligence_notification_delivery_state() — keeps delivery state in sync
functional_parts.auth: server-side trigger path (emission from receipts); delivery state synced by trigger
functional_parts.name: Intelligence notification bus

functional_parts.action_binding: RPC public.nayanet_join_space(p_space_id uuid) / public.nayanet_leave_space(p_space_id uuid) — authenticated citizen joins or leaves a space
functional_parts.auth: RPCs EXECUTE granted to authenticated; revoked from public; triggers nayanet_space_members_touch() and nayanet_space_owner_membership() maintain timestamps and owner rows

tables: public.nayanet_space_members (space membership rows; touch/owner triggers maintain owner membership)

functional_parts.name: Space membership join/leave

functional_parts.action_binding: RPC public.nayanet_save_connection(p_target_member_id uuid, p_space_id uuid) / public.nayanet_revoke_connection(p_target_member_id uuid) — authenticated citizen saves or revokes a connection to another member in a space
functional_parts.auth: RPCs EXECUTE granted to authenticated; revoked from public
functional_parts.name: Connections save/revoke

functional_parts.action_binding: RPC public.nayanet_smart_connect(p_door text) / public.nayanet_smart_disconnect(p_door text) — citizen opts a door into/out of the collective; RPC public.nayanet_collective_wisdom_for_event(p_source_event_id uuid, p_owner_id uuid, p_wisdom_claim text, p_topic text, p_provenance jsonb) — server-side writes a collective wisdom claim (idempotency-hardened)
functional_parts.auth: nayanet_smart_connect/nayanet_smart_disconnect EXECUTE granted to authenticated (revoked from public); nayanet_collective_wisdom_for_event EXECUTE granted to service_role ONLY
functional_parts.name: Smart Connect participation and collective wisdom

functional_parts.auth: EXECUTE granted to authenticated; revoked from public and anon

writes: intelligence commit runtime bridge (cognition event lineage + runtime claims)

functional_parts.name: Intelligence commit

functional_parts.name: Smart note create (canonical pipeline)

functional_parts.action_binding: Edge Function supabase/functions/nayanet-verified-ai-action (POST) — verifies the authority grant for action 'naya_node_apply', then executes the governed action and writes receipt+outcome, or writes a refusal receipt. Sibling: supabase/functions/nayanet-act-runtime (act.ts / decision-context.ts).
functional_parts.auth: edge function verifies GitHub Actions OIDC; authority resolved from durable grant BEFORE any governed effect; refusal recorded as receipt when grant absent/inactive/revoked/expired/out-of-scope

reads: public.nayanet_authority_grants (grant resolution: active, unrevoked, unexpired, mission+scope+action match, same owner)
writes: public.nayanet_execution_receipts (action='NAYA-NODE-0001-VERIFIED-AI-ACTION' or REFUSAL action; idempotent by idempotency_key)

functional_parts.name: Verified AI action runtime (authority-gated execution)
